bioconda.name: timsrust_pyo3
bioconda.summary: Python bindings to the TimsRust reader
bioconda.description:
timsrust_pyo3 provides Python bindings to TimsRust, a high-performance Rust ecosystem for reading and preprocessing Bruker timsTOF mass spectrometry data.
TimsRust provides type-safe, composable abstractions for working with liquid chromatography coupled to trapped ion mobility spectrometry (LC-TIMS-TOF) data in multiple formats.
